# 0.14.0

2026-06-12 · [View on GitHub](https://github.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/releases/tag/v0.14.0)

## What's New

**New features**
- Repository quality grade and shields.io badge support (`skillsaw badge`)
- Benchmarking framework for performance regression testing (`make benchmark`)

**Performance**
- Optimized linting hot paths: **2.3–2.6x faster** across the board

**Fixes**
- Restricted badge JSON output to the shields.io endpoint schema
- Fixed `marketplace-registration` autofix crash on malformed input
- Expanded autofix and malformed-input test coverage
